name: fast-laya-compaction
description: Verbatim Laya-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions, judged by a local open-weights model.

baseUrl.title: Laya server URL
baseUrl.description: System One endpoint of your laya-server. Leave unset to use LAYA_BASE_URL, then http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1/systemone.

apiKey.title: Laya API key (optional)
apiKey.description: Bearer token, only if your laya-server sits behind auth. Leave unset to use LAYA_API_KEY, or none.

model.title: Laya model
model.description: laya-english (512-token window), laya-multilingual or laya-typed-decisions (1024), or the laya router.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Laya probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum state tokens per call
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the focused state sent with each call's questions. Leave unset to use the model's default (320 for laya-english, 768 for the 1024-token models).

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Laya decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: Laya requests in flight at once (one per candidate tool call).
